newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks remain higher on financial buying.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks remain higher on financial buying.

text.p: Taiwan share prices remained higher in late Friday trade on active buying of the heavily weighted financial sector, brokers said.
With 65 minutes to go, at 0255 GMT, the weighted index had gained 79.08 points or 0.99 percent to 8,075.18. Turnover was T$60 billion.
Financials outperformed other shares to rise 2.56 percent.
Brokers said jitters over unsettled domestic politics are gradually easing.

"President Lee Teng-hui made it very clear in Thursday's news conference that Premier Lien Chan will step down in July and the main opposition party appears to welcome Lee's statement," said George Hou, a fund manager at Jardine Fleming.
"Many people are not completely satisfied, but the market has accepted it as a fact. As worries over local politics ease, confidence should gradually recover," Hou added.
